import Mathlib

structure BipartiteGraph where
  adj : Array (Array Nat)

def BipartiteGraph.well_formed (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.adj.size →
    ∀ v, v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → v < g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.size (g : BipartiteGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def BipartiteGraph.has_edge (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  u < g.adj.size ∧
  v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[]

def BipartiteGraph.is_valid_coloring (g : BipartiteGraph) (colors : Array Bool) : Prop :=
  colors.size = g.size ∧
  ∀ u v, g.has_edge u v →
    u < colors.size → v < colors.size → colors.getD u false ≠ colors.getD v false

def BipartiteGraph.is_bipartite (g : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  ∃ colors, g.is_valid_coloring colors

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_precond (graph : BipartiteGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace BC

/-- A label `c` encodes the pair `(root, parity)` as `2 * root + parity`. -/
def proot (c : Nat) : Nat := c / 2

def pcol (c : Nat) : Bool := c % 2 == 1

/-- Same root, opposite parity. -/
def flipL (c : Nat) : Nat := 2 * (c / 2) + (1 - c % 2)

lemma proot_flipL (c : Nat) : proot (flipL c) = proot c := by
  unfold proot flipL; omega

lemma pcol_flipL (c : Nat) : pcol (flipL c) = !(pcol c) := by
  have h1 : flipL c % 2 = 1 - c % 2 := by unfold flipL; omega
  have h2 := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one c
  simp only [pcol, h1]
  rcases h2 with h | h <;> simp [h]

/-- Boolean test for `has_edge`. -/
def hasE (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (u < g.adj.size) && decide (v ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList)

lemma hasE_iff (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) : hasE g u v = true ↔ g.has_edge u v := by
  simp only [hasE, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, Array.mem_toList_iff]
  exact Iff.rfl

/-- Undirected neighbours of `u`. -/
def symNbrs (g : BipartiteGraph) (u : Nat) : List Nat :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).filter (fun v => hasE g u v || hasE g v u)

def minF (f : Nat → Nat) (a v : Nat) : Nat := min a (f v)

lemma foldl_le (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat), l.foldl (minF f) a ≤ a := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    exact le_trans (ih (minF f a x)) (min_le_left _ _)

lemma foldl_le_mem (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a v : Nat), v ∈ l →
    l.foldl (minF f) a ≤ f v := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a v hv; cases hv
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro a v hv
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with h | h
    · subst h; exact le_trans (foldl_le f xs _) (min_le_right _ _)
    · exact ih _ v h

lemma foldl_mem (f : Nat → Nat) : ∀ (l : List Nat) (a : Nat),
    l.foldl (minF f) a = a ∨ ∃ v ∈ l, l.foldl (minF f) a = f v := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro a; left; simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rcases ih (minF f a x) with h | ⟨v, hv, h⟩
    · rw [h]
      unfold minF
      rcases le_total a (f x) with h2 | h2
      · left; exact min_eq_left h2
      · right; exact ⟨x, by simp, min_eq_right h2⟩
    · right; exact ⟨v, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hv, h⟩

/-- One parallel relaxation round. -/
def round (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) (u : Nat) : Nat :=
  (symNbrs g u).foldl (minF (fun v => flipL (L v))) (L u)

lemma round_le (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) (u : Nat) : round g L u ≤ L u :=
  foldl_le (fun v => flipL (L v)) (symNbrs g u) (L u)

def phi (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) : Nat := ∑ u ∈ Finset.range g.adj.size, L u

def unstable (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).any (fun u => decide (round g L u ≠ L u))

lemma phi_lt (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) (h : unstable g L = true) :
    phi g (round g L) < phi g L := by
  unfold unstable at h
  rw [List.any_eq_true] at h
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hne⟩ := h
  have hne' : round g L u ≠ L u := by simpa using hne
  refine Finset.sum_lt_sum (fun i _ => round_le g L i) ?_
  exact ⟨u, Finset.mem_range.mpr (List.mem_range.mp hu), lt_of_le_of_ne (round_le g L u) hne'⟩

/-- Relax until the label vector is stable. -/
def loop (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat :=
  if h : unstable g L = true then loop g (round g L) else L
termination_by phi g L
decreasing_by exact phi_lt g L h

lemma loop_eq (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) :
    loop g L = if h : unstable g L = true then loop g (round g L) else L := by
  rw [loop]

def L0 : Nat → Nat := fun u => 2 * u

def solve (g : BipartiteGraph) : Nat → Nat := loop g L0

def colorsOf (g : BipartiteGraph) : Array Bool :=
  Array.ofFn (n := g.adj.size) (fun i => pcol (solve g i.1))

def okAll (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) : Bool :=
  (List.range g.adj.size).all
    (fun u => ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).all (fun v => decide (pcol (L u) ≠ pcol (L v))))

/-- One step of the parity walk relation: adjacent (in either direction) with flipped colour. -/
def bstep (g : BipartiteGraph) (x y : Nat × Bool) : Prop :=
  (g.has_edge x.1 y.1 ∨ g.has_edge y.1 x.1) ∧ y.2 = !x.2

abbrev Reach (g : BipartiteGraph) (x y : Nat × Bool) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (bstep g) x y

/-- Soundness invariant of the propagation. -/
def Inv (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, Reach g (proot (L u), false) (u, pcol (L u))

end BC
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def check_bipartite (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Option (Array Bool) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  if BC.okAll graph (BC.solve graph) = true then some (BC.colorsOf graph) else none
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def check_bipartite_postcond (graph : BipartiteGraph) (result : Option (Array Bool))
    (_ : check_bipartite_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some colors => graph.is_valid_coloring colors
  | none => ¬ graph.is_bipartite
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace BC

lemma symNbrs_edge (g : BipartiteGraph) {u v : Nat} (hv : v ∈ symNbrs g u) :
    g.has_edge u v ∨ g.has_edge v u := by
  unfold symNbrs at hv
  rw [List.mem_filter] at hv
  have h := hv.2
  rw [Bool.or_eq_true] at h
  rcases h with h | h
  · exact Or.inl ((hasE_iff g u v).mp h)
  · exact Or.inr ((hasE_iff g v u).mp h)

lemma mem_symNbrs (g : BipartiteGraph) (u v : Nat) (hv : v < g.adj.size)
    (h : hasE g u v = true ∨ hasE g v u = true) : v ∈ symNbrs g u := by
  unfold symNbrs
  rw [List.mem_filter]
  refine ⟨List.mem_range.mpr hv, ?_⟩
  rcases h with h | h <;> simp [h]

lemma round_inv (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) (h : Inv g L) : Inv g (round g L) := by
  intro u
  rcases foldl_mem (fun v => flipL (L v)) (symNbrs g u) (L u) with he | ⟨v, hv, he⟩
  · have he' : round g L u = L u := he
    rw [he']
    exact h u
  · have he' : round g L u = flipL (L v) := he
    rw [he', proot_flipL, pcol_flipL]
    have hb : bstep g (v, pcol (L v)) (u, !(pcol (L v))) := by
      refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
      rcases symNbrs_edge g hv with h1 | h1
      · exact Or.inr h1
      · exact Or.inl h1
    exact Relation.ReflTransGen.tail (h v) hb

lemma init_inv (g : BipartiteGraph) : Inv g L0 := by
  intro u
  have h1 : proot (L0 u) = u := by unfold proot L0; omega
  have h2 : pcol (L0 u) = false := by
    unfold pcol L0
    simp
  rw [h1, h2]

lemma loop_spec (g : BipartiteGraph) (hw : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ (n : Nat) (L : Nat → Nat), phi g L ≤ n → Inv g L →
      Inv g (loop g L) ∧ unstable g (loop g L) = false := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro L hphi hinv
    have hst : ¬ (unstable g L = true) := by
      intro hc
      have := phi_lt g L hc
      omega
    rw [loop_eq, dif_neg hst]
    exact ⟨hinv, by simpa using hst⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro L hphi hinv
    by_cases hc : unstable g L = true
    · rw [loop_eq, dif_pos hc]
      have hlt := phi_lt g L hc
      exact ih (round g L) (by omega) (round_inv g L hinv)
    · rw [loop_eq, dif_neg hc]
      exact ⟨hinv, by simpa using hc⟩

lemma solve_inv (g : BipartiteGraph) (hw : g.well_formed) : Inv g (solve g) :=
  (loop_spec g hw (phi g L0) L0 le_rfl (init_inv g)).1

lemma solve_stable (g : BipartiteGraph) (hw : g.well_formed) : unstable g (solve g) = false :=
  (loop_spec g hw (phi g L0) L0 le_rfl (init_inv g)).2

lemma stable_round (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) (hs : unstable g L = false)
    {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) : round g L u = L u := by
  by_contra hne
  have hc : unstable g L = true := by
    unfold unstable
    rw [List.any_eq_true]
    exact ⟨u, List.mem_range.mpr hu, by simpa using hne⟩
  rw [hc] at hs
  exact Bool.noConfusion hs

lemma stable_le (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) (hs : unstable g L = false) {u v : Nat}
    (hu : u < g.adj.size) (hv : v ∈ symNbrs g u) : L u ≤ flipL (L v) := by
  have h1 := stable_round g L hs hu
  rw [← h1]
  exact foldl_le_mem (fun v => flipL (L v)) (symNbrs g u) (L u) v hv

lemma reach_sound (g : BipartiteGraph) (hw : g.well_formed) (col : Array Bool)
    (hc : g.is_valid_coloring col) {x y : Nat × Bool} (h : Reach g x y) :
    xor (col.getD x.1 false) x.2 = xor (col.getD y.1 false) y.2 := by
  have hsz : col.size = g.adj.size := hc.1
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | @tail b c h1 h2 ih =>
    obtain ⟨hedge, hpar⟩ := h2
    have hb : b.1 < col.size ∧ c.1 < col.size := by
      rcases hedge with he | he
      · exact ⟨by rw [hsz]; exact he.1, by rw [hsz]; exact hw b.1 he.1 c.1 he.2⟩
      · exact ⟨by rw [hsz]; exact hw c.1 he.1 b.1 he.2, by rw [hsz]; exact he.1⟩
    have hne : col.getD b.1 false ≠ col.getD c.1 false := by
      rcases hedge with he | he
      · exact hc.2 b.1 c.1 he hb.1 hb.2
      · exact (hc.2 c.1 b.1 he hb.2 hb.1).symm
    have hflip : col.getD c.1 false = !(col.getD b.1 false) := by
      rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (col.getD b.1 false) with h5 | h5 <;>
        rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (col.getD c.1 false) with h6 | h6 <;>
        rw [h5, h6] at hne ⊢ <;> simp_all
    rw [ih, hpar, hflip]
    rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true (col.getD b.1 false) with h5 | h5 <;>
      rcases Bool.eq_false_or_eq_true b.2 with h6 | h6 <;> rw [h5, h6] <;> rfl

lemma getD_colors (g : BipartiteGraph) {u : Nat} (hu : u < g.adj.size) :
    (colorsOf g).getD u false = pcol (solve g u) := by
  unfold colorsOf
  rw [Array.getD_eq_getD_getElem?]
  simp [hu]

lemma okAll_spec (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) (h : okAll g L = true) {u v : Nat}
    (he : g.has_edge u v) : pcol (L u) ≠ pcol (L v) := by
  unfold okAll at h
  rw [List.all_eq_true] at h
  have h1 := h u (List.mem_range.mpr he.1)
  rw [List.all_eq_true] at h1
  have h2 : v ∈ (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList := by
    first
      | exact Array.mem_toList_iff.mpr he.2
      | exact Array.mem_def.mp he.2
      | exact Array.mem_toList_iff.mp he.2
      | exact Array.mem_def.mpr he.2
  simpa using h1 v h2

lemma not_ok_witness (g : BipartiteGraph) (L : Nat → Nat) (h : okAll g L = false) :
    ∃ u v, g.has_edge u v ∧ pcol (L u) = pcol (L v) := by
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hall : okAll g L = true := by
    unfold okAll
    rw [List.all_eq_true]
    intro u hu
    rw [List.all_eq_true]
    intro v hv
    have hv' : v ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] := by
      first
        | exact Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hv
        | exact Array.mem_def.mpr hv
        | exact Array.mem_toList_iff.mpr hv
        | exact Array.mem_def.mp hv
    have he : g.has_edge u v := ⟨List.mem_range.mp hu, hv'⟩
    simpa using hcon u v he
  rw [hall] at h
  exact Bool.noConfusion h

lemma main_some (g : BipartiteGraph) (hw : g.well_formed) (h : okAll g (solve g) = true) :
    g.is_valid_coloring (colorsOf g) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [colorsOf, BipartiteGraph.size], ?_⟩
  intro u v he _ _
  have hun : u < g.adj.size := he.1
  have hvn : v < g.adj.size := hw u he.1 v he.2
  rw [getD_colors g hun, getD_colors g hvn]
  exact okAll_spec g (solve g) h he

lemma main_none (g : BipartiteGraph) (hw : g.well_formed) (h : okAll g (solve g) = false) :
    ¬ g.is_bipartite := by
  rintro ⟨col, hcol⟩
  obtain ⟨u, v, he, hpc⟩ := not_ok_witness g (solve g) h
  have hun : u < g.adj.size := he.1
  have hvn : v < g.adj.size := hw u he.1 v he.2
  have hs := solve_stable g hw
  have hE : hasE g u v = true := (hasE_iff g u v).mpr he
  have h1 : solve g u ≤ flipL (solve g v) :=
    stable_le g (solve g) hs hun (mem_symNbrs g u v hvn (Or.inl hE))
  have h2 : solve g v ≤ flipL (solve g u) :=
    stable_le g (solve g) hs hvn (mem_symNbrs g v u hun (Or.inr hE))
  have hpar : solve g u % 2 = solve g v % 2 := by
    have ha := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (solve g u)
    have hb := Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (solve g v)
    unfold pcol at hpc
    rcases ha with a | a <;> rcases hb with b | b <;> rw [a, b] at hpc <;> simp at hpc <;> omega
  have hroot : proot (solve g u) = proot (solve g v) := by
    unfold proot
    unfold flipL at h1 h2
    omega
  have hinv := solve_inv g hw
  have r1 := reach_sound g hw col hcol (hinv u)
  have r2 := reach_sound g hw col hcol (hinv v)
  rw [hroot] at r1
  have h3 := r1.symm.trans r2
  simp only at h3
  rw [hpc] at h3
  have h4 : col.getD u false = col.getD v false := by
    have h5 := congrArg (fun b => xor b (pcol (solve g v))) h3
    simpa [Bool.xor_assoc] using h5
  exact (hcol.2 u v he (by rw [hcol.1]; exact hun) (by rw [hcol.1]; exact hvn)) h4

end BC
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem check_bipartite_postcond_satisfied (graph : BipartiteGraph)
    (h_precond : check_bipartite_precond graph) :
    check_bipartite_postcond graph (check_bipartite graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold check_bipartite
  by_cases hok : BC.okAll graph (BC.solve graph) = true
  · rw [if_pos hok]
    exact BC.main_some graph h_precond hok
  · rw [if_neg hok]
    exact BC.main_none graph h_precond (by simpa using hok)
  -- !benchmark @end proof
